# Clinical Center for Speech & Psychology — Rawalpindi

> Clinical Center for Speech & Psychology (CCSP) is a licensed speech-language pathology and psychological services clinic located at ADYALA, Defence Road, Rawalpindi 46200, Pakistan. It serves families across Rawalpindi, Islamabad, Askari 1–14, DHA, Bahria Town, and the Khawaja Corporation / Adyala Road corridor. The clinic has been operating since 2014, has helped 500+ patients, and is open Monday–Saturday, 9am–5pm. Phone: 0331-880-7617.

CCSP provides two primary service categories:
- **Pediatric Speech & Language Therapy** — for children with speech delays, Autism, ADHD, stuttering, feeding difficulties, and AAC needs.
- **Adult Neuro-Rehabilitation** — for adults with post-stroke aphasia, dysarthria, apraxia, dysphagia, voice disorders, and neurodegenerative conditions (Parkinson's, Dementia, ALS).

The clinic is one of the few in the twin cities offering LSVT LOUD (Parkinson's voice treatment) and evidence-based AAC (Augmentative & Alternative Communication) assessment.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://ccsp.pk/): Overview of the clinic, services, trust signals, and appointment booking.
- [About Us](https://ccsp.pk/about): Clinic background, founding year (2014), philosophy, and team overview.
- [Contact & Visit](https://ccsp.pk/contact): Address (ADYALA, Defence Road, Rawalpindi), phone (0331-880-7617), hours (Mon–Sat 9am–5pm), and Google Maps directions.

## Pediatric Services

- [Pediatric Services Overview](https://ccsp.pk/pediatric-services): All pediatric therapy services for children and adolescents.
- [Speech Sound & Articulation Therapy](https://ccsp.pk/pediatric-services/speech-articulation): Targeted intervention for phonological delays and articulation errors in children.
- [Language Intervention (Receptive & Expressive)](https://ccsp.pk/pediatric-services/language-intervention): Building vocabulary, comprehension, and sentence structure for children with language delays or disorders.
- [Fluency Shaping (Stuttering / Cluttering)](https://ccsp.pk/pediatric-services/fluency-shaping): Evidence-based fluency therapy for children and teenagers who stutter or clutter.
- [Social Communication & Play Therapy](https://ccsp.pk/pediatric-services/social-communication): Pragmatic language and social skills for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder, ADHD, and Social Communication Disorder.
- [Pediatric Feeding & Orofacial Myofunctional Therapy](https://ccsp.pk/pediatric-services/feeding-therapy): Support for feeding difficulties, extreme picky eating, oral-motor disorders, tongue posture, and pediatric dysphagia.
- [AAC Therapy (Augmentative & Alternative Communication)](https://ccsp.pk/pediatric-services/aac-therapy): PECS, speech generating devices (SGDs), and total communication for non-speaking or minimally verbal children.

## Adult Rehabilitation Services

- [Adult Services Overview](https://ccsp.pk/adult-services): All adult neuro-rehabilitation and voice services.
- [Aphasia & Cognitive-Communication Therapy](https://ccsp.pk/adult-services/aphasia-therapy): Language rehabilitation after stroke and traumatic brain injury.
- [Motor Speech Therapy (Dysarthria & Apraxia)](https://ccsp.pk/adult-services/motor-speech): Improving speech intelligibility and motor planning after neurological injury. LSVT LOUD available.
- [Dysphagia (Swallowing Rehabilitation)](https://ccsp.pk/adult-services/dysphagia-therapy): Clinical swallowing assessment and therapy for stroke, Parkinson's, and neurological conditions.
- [Clinical Voice & Resonance Therapy](https://ccsp.pk/adult-services/voice-therapy): Voice rehabilitation for hoarseness, vocal nodules, and professional voice users (teachers, lecturers, imams).
- [Neurodegenerative Communication Management](https://ccsp.pk/adult-services/neurodegenerative): Long-term communication and swallowing support for Parkinson's disease, Dementia, Alzheimer's, and ALS. LSVT LOUD offered.
